pages.title: Andrés Blitz | Full-Time Trader & Investor, British Columbia
pages.summary: Andrés Blitz is a full-time trader and investor in British Columbia, Canada — markets, portfolio construction, and capital allocation. Sharp instincts from years in high-stakes sales and operations.

pages.title: Blitz Analytics — Privacy-Minded Web Analytics | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Blitz Analytics is the small private analytics and chat backend behind andresblitz.com: a Cloudflare Worker with a D1 database, first-party visitor ids and no raw IP storage. Demo uses sample data.

pages.title: Blitzy's World — Playable Space Game in the Browser | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Play Blitzy's World: fly a glowing orb through an endless procedural universe, slingshot around planets and collect stardust. Built with HTML5 Canvas; works with keyboard, mouse and touch.

pages.title: Blitzy's World — 3D Levels (v0.3) | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Blitzy's World v0.3 — 4 levels. Catch stars, evade aliens, dodge asteroids around a purple planet. Three.js WebGL.

pages.title: Play Blitzy's World — Full Screen | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Play Blitzy's World full screen: fly a glowing orb through an endless universe, slingshot around planets and collect stardust. Keyboard, mouse and touch.

pages.title: BluthScan — Real-Time Bluetooth Scanner in 3D | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: BluthScan is a real-time Bluetooth Low Energy scanner by Andrés Blitz that renders nearby devices as a living 3D neural graph with bleak, Flask-SocketIO and 3d-force-graph. Demo uses simulated devices.

pages.title: Compute Share Pilot — Trusted Compute for AI | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Compute Share Pilot is a proof of concept by Andrés Blitz for trusted friends to share spare computer power over the internet: a coordinator, polling workers behind NAT and whole-request routing to local LLMs.

pages.title: Currency RSS — FX Rates and Central-Bank Feed | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Currency RSS by Andrés Blitz: a free RSS 2.0 feed of Latin American dollar rates, Bitcoin, USD/CAD and central-bank policy rates, rebuilt every 30 minutes by GitHub Actions with a source and timestamp on every item.

pages.title: Elevatron — Space-Access Beam Concept Study | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Elevatron is a fully-cited concept study by Andrés Blitz: can a magnetically-pinched, laser-coupled beam act as both conductor and structure for space access? Physics, feasibility and safe benchtop demos.

pages.title: Elite Island Movers — Moving Company Website | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: A simple one-page website Andrés Blitz built for a local moving company in British Columbia: services, clear hourly pricing and local-business structured data. Plain HTML and CSS.

pages.title: Home History — Time-Capsule House Timeline | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Home History is a time-capsule web app by Andrés Blitz: past and present residents add photos and stories to a shared timeline for a home. Next.js, TypeScript and SQLite MVP.

pages.title: Projects by Andrés Blitz — Trading Tools, Games & Experiments
pages.summary: Every project by Andrés Blitz, each with its own page: a playable space game, a real estate portfolio dashboard, trading indicators, signal and network tools, research and web apps.

pages.title: IPTV Player — Latin America & USA Live TV | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: A fast, dark-mode IPTV web player for Latin American and US channels by Andrés Blitz: HLS.js playback, search, favorites, history, custom M3U playlists and automatic dead-channel removal.

pages.title: Blitz Engine — Behavioral Signal Analyzer | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Blitz Engine is an open-source behavioral signal analyzer: 40 live webcam, audio, language and pulse cues fused with Bayesian log-odds and a personal baseline. Not a lie detector — and honest about it.

pages.title: NetWatch — Local Network Monitoring Dashboard | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: NetWatch is a local network monitoring dashboard by Andrés Blitz: live bandwidth, connections, devices, intrusion detection and 30-day history, served by a small Python Flask app. Demo uses simulated data.

pages.title: Quiniela — World Cup 2026 Prediction Pool for Friends | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Quiniela is a World Cup 2026 prediction pool by Andrés Blitz: nickname + PIN sign-in, real-time sync with Firebase, live scores, group consensus odds and automatic standings.

pages.title: RealWealth Portfolio — Real Estate Dashboard | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: RealWealth Portfolio is the real estate portfolio manager Andrés Blitz uses for his own holdings: properties, mortgages, market data, MLS® listings and a Bitcoin sleeve in one Next.js dashboard. The live app is embedded on this page.

pages.title: SIGNET — Signal Network Visualization Thesis | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: SIGNET is a research thesis by Andrés Blitz on unifying 42 signal channels — IP, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, optical — into one spatial intelligence layer, where patterns appear when signals are paired.

pages.title: SIGSPACE — Network Signals as a Video Game World | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: SIGSPACE is a browser game where you are a pixel character inside your own network: IP, DNS, Bluetooth and threat signals orbit you, and a frequency dial switches realms. Canvas + Cloudflare Workers.

pages.title: Weinstein Stage Matrix — TradingView Indicator | Andrés Blitz
pages.summary: Weinstein Stage Matrix is a Pine Script indicator by Andrés Blitz that classifies charts into Stan Weinstein's four stages on a weekly-first 30-period MA engine. Demo uses synthetic prices.

pages.title: Salario en dólares: convierte pesos, bolívares o soles a USD
pages.summary: Convierte tu salario mensual o anual en bolívares, pesos colombianos, mexicanos, argentinos (oficial y blue), soles, pesos chilenos o dólares canadienses a dólares estadounidenses con tasas de referencia actualizadas.

pages.title: Tasa BCV hoy: dólar BCV y euro en bolívares | Venezuela
pages.summary: Tasa BCV hoy: dólar BCV, euro y paralelo en bolívares, bitcoin en Bs y calculadoras de cambio, préstamos e IVA para Venezuela, Maracaibo y Zulia.
